effect: The load test completes the feedback loop: the flexor lengthens, sensory signals travel toward the spinal cord, and adjusted muscle activity steadies the cup.
reaction: The three-panel sequence makes the purpose of the connections clear, although the intervening processing is only broadly described.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the load was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects stretch sensing and motor output to a recognizable adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the cup was clear but mechanically straightforward; it mainly prepared the test.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see another concrete feedback example, though most choices here were the only offered combination.
